title: Municipal Library Paper Archive Digitalization Proposal
subtitle: Pursuant to Archives Act Article 15 & Library Bylaw Article 42
argument: The 184,000 physical volumes in the collection shall enter online archival management in Q3 to fulfill Archives Act Article 15 and Library Bylaw Article 42.
Physical vault capacity has reached 94.2%; this proposal establishes climate control and audit sampling to maintain statutory safety standards.
evidence: A 15% stratified sample of the 184,000 volumes verified paper acidification rates remain below the 0.08% threshold.
Engineers certified the environmental control vault structural load and seismic safety factor at 2.45.
Quarterly physical audits covering 15% of core historical records will ensure document integrity over the 30-year retention period.
next_step: The Library Committee is requested to review and approve this proposal under Bylaw Article 8 for Q3 deployment.
